name: Text to Speech
description: Speak in the channel with Mistral Voxtral voices. A reference clip is cloned for one line and never saved.
author: Maxwell

prompt.text: tts speaks one Discord voice message of any length. A success returns nothing: do not call tts again, and do not send_message the same line. An error is returned: fix the voice or emotion and retry once. A cooldown error means wait, do not retry in this turn. voice= paul, oliver, jane, or marie. emotion= applies to those presets (happy, sad, angry, frustrated, excited, confident, cheerful, neutral, sarcastic, curious, confused, jealous, ashamed). reference= clones an audio attachment for that one line only. Clones are never saved, and there is no saved-voice list.
